outputs.prompt: Compose a desktop Settings dialog over the existing Fall Card Hall at 1600 × 900. Keep the Hall, activity cards and HUD in place under a dim scrim. Use the approved simplified mockup as the layout reference when editing. Center a compact charcoal panel with a fine brass edge, Cinzel title and Spline Sans controls. Align General, Audio and Accessibility controls in quiet rows; make the active appearance and motion options clear. Keep Close, Done and a subdued Credits link easy to find. Use the app’s existing type, color and radius tokens.

Keep the same Card Hall backdrop, centered dialog, copy, controls and section order. Render a more ornate material study with engraved brass trim, subtly textured charcoal, recessed controls and a framed oxblood Done action. Keep labels and selected states crisp.
